hero.title: Home, auto, and commercial insurance in Houston, TX.
hero.lead: As a fully independent insurance broker, we can help you find the most cost-effective and comprehensive auto, home, and commercial insurance coverage on the market. We work with a variety of insurance companies to help you get the best fitting and most affordable plan, no matter your situation.
hero.imageAlt: An insurance agent going through policy options with a couple at a desk

overview.title: We offer knowledge, service, and experience.
overview.text: Pick a line of coverage to see what it includes, or call and talk it through with an agent.

services.title: Auto Insurance
services.text: Get bare bones auto insurance or comprehensive coverage for vehicles of all kinds and families of all sizes.
services.lead: Texas law requires everyone driving a vehicle on the road to be covered by automobile insurance, and the state mandates the coverage amounts. We are fully independent, so we can help you get auto insurance from a variety of carriers, which means greater pricing power for you and more options when it comes to car insurance.
services.imageAlt: A small yellow car parked at the kerb on a residential street

covers.title: Collision coverage
covers.text: Covers damage to your vehicle in the event of a collision with another vehicle or object.

covers.title: Comprehensive coverage
covers.text: Covers damage to your vehicle caused by events other than a collision, such as theft, fire, getting hit by a running deer, or vandalism.

covers.title: Liability coverage
covers.text: Covers any legal costs and damages you may be liable for if you cause an accident.

covers.title: Medical payments coverage
covers.text: Covers medical expenses for you and your passengers if you are involved in an accident.

covers.title: Uninsured and underinsured motorist
covers.text: Covers you if you are hit by an uninsured or underinsured driver.

covers.title: Rental car coverage
covers.text: Covers the cost of a rental car if your vehicle is damaged in an accident.

questions.q: How much auto liability does Texas require?
questions.a: According to state law, Texas drivers need minimum coverage of $30,000 per injured person, up to at least $60,000 per accident, and coverage for property damage of at least $25,000.
It covers medical expenses, lost wages, and other costs associated with an injury sustained in an accident. We can quote it alongside the rest of your policy.

questions.q: Will you push me into coverage I do not need?
questions.a: No. We will help you navigate what you need and what you do not, and plans can be tailored to your vehicles and lifestyle.

services.title: Homeowners Insurance
services.text: Get peace of mind that your home is covered in the event of a catastrophe.
services.lead: Homeowners insurance covers your private residence and most of the property inside and on the premises. It is typically an all-in-one policy that covers both damage to the home and liability for any injuries and property damage caused by the owner or their family members.
services.imageAlt: A bright kitchen with a central island in a family home

covers.title: Dwelling coverage
covers.text: Covers damage to the physical structure of the home and usually attached garages, detached garages, and sheds. Small farms and properties with larger out-buildings and more acreage may need a farmowners policy instead.

covers.title: Personal property coverage
covers.text: Covers the cost of replacing personal belongings that are damaged or stolen, including vehicles and property in garages or sheds.

covers.title: Liability coverage
covers.text: Covers liability for accidents or injuries that occur on the property and involve other people or other people's property.

covers.title: Additional living expenses
covers.text: Covers the cost of additional living expenses incurred due to a covered loss, when the home is damaged to the point you cannot live there for a time.

questions.q: What does a homeowners policy usually cover?
questions.a: Policies typically cover damage or loss caused by fire, lightning, windstorms, hail, and other natural disasters, and a good plan can also cover theft, vandalism, and other types of unexpected losses.

questions.q: Can you write a policy for a rental property?
questions.a: Yes. We can help you get a policy for your home, your rental, or other property.

questions.q: Why go through an independent broker for home insurance?
questions.a: We are not tied to any particular insurance company, so we shop around for the best prices and coverage, and we can offer a wide range of products to fit your needs.

questions.q: Do I need homeowners insurance if I have a mortgage?
questions.a: Mortgage providers require homeowners insurance, and there is a good reason for it: a home is the biggest investment most people have.

services.title: Life Insurance
services.text: Term, whole, and universal insurance. We can help you find the right coverage to provide for you or your loved ones.
services.lead: Life insurance is about the people who depend on you. We go through term, whole, and universal coverage with you one on one, and help you find the plan that fits your family and your budget.
services.imageAlt: A family walking together along a tree-lined street

covers.title: Term life
covers.text: Coverage for a set number of years, often matched to the years your family depends on your income.

covers.title: Whole life
covers.text: Permanent coverage that stays in force for life and builds value over time.

covers.title: Universal life
covers.text: Permanent coverage with flexibility in the premium and the death benefit as your circumstances change.

questions.q: How do I know how much coverage I need?
questions.a: We offer a one-on-one advising approach, so we work through it with you rather than handing you a number.

questions.q: How do I get a quote for Mexico insurance?

services.title: Commercial Insurance
services.text: For businesses and business vehicles, we provide commercial insurance for commercial endeavors of all kinds.
services.lead: Whatever line of business you are in, there are risks. A vehicle collision could create untold liabilities if someone else is injured, your business property could be stolen or damaged, or you might face unexpected lawsuits from past or disgruntled customers. Commercial insurance is designed to provide financial protection against the losses that come out of the blue.
services.imageAlt: A small team working together around a laptop in an office

covers.title: General liability
covers.text: Protection against claims that arise in the course of normal business operations, including the cost of legal fees and damages.

covers.title: Business owners policy
covers.text: A package that brings the core coverages a small business needs together in one policy.

covers.title: Commercial property
covers.text: Your building, equipment and inventory against damage and theft, including natural disaster and fire damage.

covers.title: Commercial auto
covers.text: Liability and damage coverage for the vehicles your business runs on.

covers.title: Workers compensation
covers.text: Coverage for employee injuries that happen on the job.

covers.title: Cyber and professional liability
covers.text: Cyber liability, professional liability, product liability and errors and omissions, for the risks that do not show up on a balance sheet.

questions.q: How quickly can my business be covered?
questions.a: Within days, we can have most businesses fully insured and ready for anything.

questions.q: Is my business too small for a commercial policy?
questions.a: No matter how complex or simple your business, from a 30-person accounting firm to a one-person landscaping company, we can help you protect what matters most: your family and your income.

questions.q: What does commercial insurance protect against?
questions.a: It helps mitigate the financial risks of running a business, such as lawsuits, property damage, and employee injuries, and it can be built to cover loss of income due to natural disasters or other unexpected events.

questions.q: Does a commercial policy cover lost income?
questions.a: Commercial policies may also cover loss of income and profits, as well as business interruption, and in the case of a lawsuit they can cover the cost of legal fees and damages.

services.title: Business Vehicle Insurance
services.summary: Coverage for the vehicles you work in.
services.text: Commercial coverage for business vehicles, from a single work vehicle to the whole operation.
services.lead: Whether you need a simple policy to cover your work vehicle or a comprehensive approach to risk management, we can help you get commercial insurance coverage that will fit your budget.
services.imageAlt: A driver at the wheel of a vehicle, seen from the passenger side

questions.q: Why insure a work vehicle commercially?
questions.a: A vehicle collision could create untold liabilities if someone else is injured. Commercial coverage is built for the way the vehicle is actually used.

questions.q: Can you cover more than one vehicle?
questions.a: Yes. Call, email, or stop by and we will put together coverage around how your business operates.

process.title: How it works
process.text: The same three steps whether you are insuring one car or a whole business.

steps.title: Get a quote
steps.text: We will help you understand your liabilities and risks, then come up with coverage that makes sense for your goals. We get a variety of quotes from the carriers and present your options.

steps.title: Get great coverage
steps.text: You get covered. Within days, we can have most businesses fully insured and ready for anything.

faqs.q: What does being a fully independent broker mean?
faqs.a: We work with a variety of insurance companies rather than one, so we can shop your coverage around and find the best fitting and most affordable plan.

faqs.q: Is auto insurance required in Texas?
faqs.a: Yes. Without auto insurance, state law prohibits you from driving a car on public roads, and the state mandates the coverage amounts.

faqs.q: How do I renew a policy?

faqs.q: Can you text me about my policy?
